title: i18n ticket pack (R46; §9.3/§9.11)
description: Shape of packages/content/packs/*.i18n.json. Only the subset this repo's script/validate.mjs interpreter understands is used here (type, enum, pattern, minimum/maximum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, maxProperties). The deeper laws — decision/flavour namespace partition, {slot} syntax + glossary coverage, era-variant object shape, README §Key literals verbatim sync, §9.11 technique-vocabulary ban-list — are hand-enforced in the validator, not expressible in this subset.

eraCodes.description: Declared era axis for {eras,...} variant objects, code -> meaning. Keys are 4-digit years.

slots.description: Slot glossary; every {token} in every template must appear here, and every entry must be used at least once.

decision.description: Sober surface: strings shown while deciding or losing (labels, terms, refusals, alerts, status rungs). §9.3 clauses 2-3. Never funny at the moment of loss.

flavour.description: Recognition comedy for quiet surfaces only (tickets, press, forums, chatter, loading tips, stickies, vendor replies, achievements, codex flavour). No bundle-referenced key may live here.

_provenance.description: One entry per template key: a §-cite string, or null where the doc gives no line to cite (nulls require _provenance._todo per never-invent law).
